verdict.rationale: ADP's package docs say RUN will create and deliver W-2 and 1099 forms and e-file them with the IRS on the employer's behalf, though this is an add-on with an additional fee. Employees can also view up to three years of W-2s/1099s online, which covers electronic distribution to workers. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the automatic year-end generation and delivery workflow (timing, delivery methods, contractor distribution specifics), independent or hands-on corroboration, and inclusion in the base package rather than as a paid add-on.
